name: Amanta Healthcare Ltd
title: Amanta Healthcare Ltd - 544502 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity doubling from 6.6 to ~12 crore bottles (SteriPort line 3) due ~20 June; management targets 24-25% EBITDA margin, but commissioning, 4-month polymer buffer and inventory build point to a slow ramp.

utilisation.quote: With utilization levels remaining healthy, we are now expanding capacity from 6.6 crore bottles per year to roughly 12 crore bottles per year.

capex.peers_comment: Management said Otsuka and B. Braun are putting some efforts in some markets; no peer capacity comments.
capex.quote: we are now expanding capacity from 6.6 crore bottles per year to roughly 12 crore bottles per year

triggers.label: Capacity 6.6 → ~12 crore bottles
triggers.quote: expanding capacity from 6.6 crore bottles per year to roughly 12 crore bottles per year

triggers.label: Polymer buffer 3 → 4 months
triggers.quote: Usually, we keep three months buffer. At the moment we keep four months buffer.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 24-25% blended
triggers.quote: we will be expecting between 24% to 25% EBITDA margin going forward

triggers.label: Receivables pulled in via price hikes
triggers.quote: as we increase the prices, they keep on paying us little early and book new orders with the existing prices

guidance.quote: we will be expecting between 24% to 25% EBITDA margin going forward
The new product line is expected to have about 27% EBITDA margin only for SteriPort

guidance.value: INR80-85 crore (assumed by analyst, accepted by management)
guidance.quote: so from 20th June we are hoping to be operational. So we should get three full quarters.
we expect it to go about 110 days in near future

guidance.value: Replace INR30-40 crore debt at lower rate in next six months
guidance.quote: we should still be able to replace around INR30 crores to INR40 crores of debt with lower interest rate in next six months also
that I think will save roughly INR75 lakh a month

red_flags.label: Working capital cycle 120-125 days
red_flags.quote: our current working capital cycle is about 100-plus days. To be precise, it will be ranging between 120 to 125 days

red_flags.label: Inventory pile-up expected post expansion
red_flags.quote: So, in first quarter there could be some ramp up of finished goods.

red_flags.label: Capacity commissioning timeline slipped; no reliable visibility
red_flags.quote: we have visibility of around three months to six months in some markets

evasions.topic: Quantifying SteriPort share of Apollo and corporate chain sales
evasions.quote: it is very, very difficult for us to exactly quantify that how much quantity went to Apollo
At this moment, I don't have the number, but I can probably dig out the numbers
